summary: # CLO 2025.0 - Rendering ## Introduction to Rendering Functions This video introduces the functions related to rendering. In the previous version of the Mac system, only CPU rendering was supported. Now, the new version also supports GPU rendering. This enhancement allows for faster Vray rendering speeds, even on Apple Silicon Macs. ## Checking GPU Rendering Let us use the test project file to check GPU rendering. First, open the rendering window. Then, click on the rendering property icon. After the rendering settings appear, open the download menu in the rendering tool category. As you can see, there is a GPU option available here. Now, let us run the actual rendering. You will see the results in the rendering window. Just like CPU rendering, GPU rendering supports all materials provided by Kolo, and the rendering speed is faster than before. **Important Note:** This function requires the installation of the latest version of the updated SDK. If your SDK is not automatically updated, please be sure to manually install the latest version. Now, even on Mac, you can experience high-speed GPU rendering. ## Customizing Focal Lengths In the new version, we can add different focal lengths for the customized view. Open the rendering window and change the current view under the video property to the customized view. Now, we need to create a customized view. Open the synchronized rendering to better set the customized view to the final desired position. After setting the customized view, under the lens property, open the actual camera settings and the depth of field options. We will change the current view to the customized view. You can see the customized view added in the list below. We also need to click on the setting focus point. Now, while in the rendering window under synchronization, click on the mouse button in the position you want to focus on. You can see the changes in the view under the lens in the property editor. Next, we use the same operation to set all the settings for the customized view. This new function can help us save a lot of time in rendering and better control the depth of each customized view, ensuring we satisfy the rendering image we are focusing on. ## AI-Generated Backgrounds From the 2025 version, we can use backgrounds generated by AI alongside the rendering image to create high-quality rendering images easily. First, from the top of the menu, click on the rendering AI model workshop. In the window that appears, click on the background option in the upper right corner. To use the background function of the AI model workshop, you first need to have a background conversion picture, which includes a transparent background image of virtual models and clothing. Please refer to the visual image displayed in the AI model workshop. We first need to change the background. Render the original picture and download the project file of the virtual model wearing the costume. Adjust the 3D window angle to the desired perspective. Then, click on the rendering option in the top main menu to open the rendering window and start rendering the costume. To ensure that the original picture and the background picture generated or uploaded integrate smoothly and seamlessly, we provide recommended picture sizes and rendering guides. To check these suggestions, click on the magic stick in the rendering tool column on the right side first. ### Recommended Settings Under the original picture part, you can see the visual image and recommended settings. It is recommended to set the rendering picture size between 2160 pixels to 4320 pixels. If the rendering picture size exceeds 4320 pixels, it will automatically adjust the picture size to 4320 pixels or less, while maintaining a fixed ratio. If the picture size is set to 2160 pixels, it can still be used, but for better quality and a more natural effect, it is best to use at least 2160 pixels. The focal point should be clear, and the quality should be high. Additionally, the main body and background must be clear and variable. If light or shadow causes the original picture to be misidentified, the result may appear unnatural. The quality of the original picture will directly affect the final result, so please pay attention to this during rendering. ### Rendering Size Considerations Click on the picture video attribute as it will ultimately generate a square background rendering picture. Therefore, when setting the rendering size of the original picture, be mindful of the pixel value, which depends on the maximum rendering size set in the original picture. For instance, if you set the original picture size to 2160 x 3840 pixels, the final output picture size will also be 3840 x 3840 pixels. After adjusting the settings according to these suggestions, click on the final rendering to output high-quality images. ## Merging Backgrounds Click on the AI model workshop again, and you will see that the final rendering picture has been automatically uploaded. By switching between the AI model workshop window and the rendering window, you can immediately merge the background picture into the rendering picture, check the results, and adjust accordingly to achieve the desired effect. Under the background selection of the AI model workshop, you can choose two options: Proposal or Picture. For the proposal, you can enter the description text you need or select keywords to generate a picture. For the picture, you can upload a picture file you like and use it as a background. ### Using Prompts for Background Generation Let’s take a look at the operation method for the prompt. You can enter the text you need to describe the background or click on the first icon in the lower right corner of the box for keyword suggestions. Choose the words you need from the recommended keywords. When you select a keyword, it will automatically be added to the text prompt section. For example, if you select "city street" and "industrial style," you will see these keywords automatically added to the prompt section. If you want to remove the selected keywords, you can click the X button on the right side of the prompt section or click the selected keyword again in the keyword suggestion to cancel the selection. After entering the prompt or selecting the keywords, click on the "start generation" next to it to generate a background picture. Press the reset button at the bottom of the background picture to restore the generated background picture to default. By clicking on the result displayed after starting the generation, you can see that even if you use the same prompt, the AI model workshop will generate a new background picture each time. If you want to keep the existing picture and change it, click on the icon with the second big needle shape to retain the keyword input, then change the prompt position. If the prompt is unchanged or if you add a new prompt, you can start generating a new background picture. For example, if you retain the keyword input and add the text prompt "bright," the background picture will be adjusted to be brighter while maintaining the original composition. ### Creative Generation Features Finally, if you want to get creative inspiration from random background pictures, you can use the random generation function, which is represented by a dice icon. This function will automatically generate random background description text to help you quickly create creative visuals. If you want to write a new prompt, click on the pencil icon in the upper right corner of the keyword prompt box to clear the prompt for easier rewriting. You can also use the keyword function to keep the input for more detailed changes. In addition, click on the question mark icon on the right side to visit the AI model workshop's handbook. Click on the history record to see all previously generated picture charts. You can double-click on the picture to re-upload it along with its corresponding text prompt. You can choose your favorite picture from the history record and click on the save icon in the upper right corner to save it as a PNG file. You can also select all the pictures and save them. Please note that picture history records will only be kept until the shell software is closed if not saved separately. ### Uploading Background Pictures Next, select the picture option and then click on upload to add the background picture we just created. Please ensure that you use a picture with copyright or no copyright issues when uploading. After successfully adding the picture file, click on the bottom of the window to start creating, applying it to the original picture. If you want to redo the original picture and background picture, simply click on the redo button next to the creation to restore it to the default state. If you are satisfied with the result of the creation, click on save at the bottom of the window and choose to save the picture in PNG or JPG format. **Final Note:** The final picture will be saved as a square, and the specific size will depend on the original picture's video attributes and the maximum pixel value set. ## Optimization Functions If you first use AI to create a face picture in the face selection and find flaws in the hair or hands, you can utilize the three optimization functions in the output image window: hair optimization, hand optimization, and clothing optimization. By clicking on hair optimization and hand optimization for this picture, you will see improvements in the final created picture, enhancing the overall aesthetic. At this point, when applying the background to this picture, the latest created face picture will automatically set as the original picture. To streamline your workflow, the new created face picture can be added to the background and saved. By utilizing the background generation function of the AI model workshop, you can easily create the clothes you designed along with various background effects that match the virtual model.
